name: @xalians/api
description: The Xalians HTTP API: registry and account lambdas. TypeScript handlers over promise-based repositories, bundled per handler by esbuild to dist/<name>/index.mjs. @aws-sdk/* is external at bundle time because nodejs22.x provides it at runtime. Creature generation is @xalians/rules; the old CommonJS engine and its routes were deleted with issue #180.
